title: Cohomology exact sequence for modifications of a normal local surface
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian normal local domain of Krull dimension $2$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and put $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $f:X\to S$ and $f':X'\to S$ be proper morphisms from integral schemes inducing isomorphisms of function fields [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-sc-function-field]. Assume $X$ is normal, meaning that every local ring is a domain integrally closed in its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $g:X'\to X$ satisfy $f\circ g=f'$. There is a short exact sequence of $A$-modules $$0\longrightarrow H^1(X,\mathcal O_X)\xrightarrow{g^*}H^1(X',\mathcal O_{X'})\longrightarrow H^0(X,R^1g_*\mathcal O_{X'})\longrightarrow0.$$ Here $H^j$ is ordinary Zariski sheaf cohomology [def-sc-zariski-cohomology], and $R^1g_*$ is the first right derived functor of direct image of module sheaves [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. No normality of $X'$ is assumed.
